tablet.notes:
Forwarding: the blue banner has an X (dismiss or never show again). While forwarding only Chats and Groups show, with no swiping to Calls or Voicemail. Tick several conversations with the circles, then tap the round send button once (Are you sure?) to send to all. You can forward pictures, videos, voice messages and contacts, not just text, and you land back in the chat you started from.
New paperclip in the message bar: attach a picture, video or audio file instead of recording it. Audio too big for a text now says so instead of staying on Sending. The message box stays on one line.
This build is signed with a new key. If the install says the app was not installed, uninstall the app once and pair again.

tablet-regular.notes:
Hold a message: the whole screen goes soft, emoji reactions sit above it and a card of actions below (Forward, Copy, Delete, Select more, Info), like Google Messages. Select more and the Details page match too.
The keyboard closes after you send and when you swipe through the messages. The voice recorder is much smaller. The tablet icon on messages another tablet sent no longer goes missing.
Fixed a crash when opening a video that had been downloaded ahead.
Since the last update: bubbles stop at about three quarters of the width.

messageplus.notes: Voicemail: after you sign in to voicemail again, the tablet no longer keeps saying the flip phone is signed out. The phone now tells the tablet right after you sign in and after every successful check.

messageplus_previous.notes:
Audio you attach from the tablet (MP3, M4A, WAV and so on) now arrives as that kind of audio instead of always being treated as a voice recording.
Updates now download from GitHub.
This build is signed with a new key. If the update says it cannot install, uninstall Message+ once and use the restore app.

tablet2.notes:
Adds a Performance log (Settings > Performance log) that records why this test copy is slow: when the screen freezes and what it was waiting on, how long loading messages takes, memory and how busy it is. Open it and use Share to send it.
Group texts from a group the tablet hasn't seen before start their own group.
